spots.name: Alamo Lake State Park
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Aubrey Peak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,540 m (5,053 ft).

spots.name: Miner's Arch
spots.tip: A natural arch. Low side light at either end of the day brings out the rock texture; at night it can frame the Milky Way.

spots.name: Swansea Peak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 686 m (2,251 ft).

spots.name: Railroad Depot Overlook
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.
